productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
This thrilling pack includes books 6–10 of the action-packed spy series, taking Kensy and Max across the globe on high-stakes missions filled with mystery, danger, and unexpected twists.


Kensy and Max 6: Full Speed Kensy and Max are sent to Zermatt to infiltrate the elusive Van Leer family, but proof of their crimes is hard to find. With a familiar face appearing in the shadows, the twins must solve multiple mysteries at once—before time runs out.


Kensy and Max 7: Take Down After their grandmother is targeted, Kensy and Max head to Singapore for the International STEM Championships. But the city holds more than just scientific wonders—danger lurks at every turn, and the twins uncover a conspiracy bigger than they ever imagined.


Kensy and Max 8: High Voltage Granny Cordelia insists on a mystery-free holiday in Portugal, but when strange incidents start piling up, Kensy and Max can’t ignore their instincts. As the E-Prix championship speeds into action, the twins realise they’ve stumbled upon a plot that could take down an entire industry.


Kensy and Max 9: Chasing Danger A catastrophic quake in New Zealand sets off a chain of events that sends Kensy and Max deep into the wilderness, tracking two escaped criminals with a grudge against Pharos. Meanwhile, strange happenings in London hint at a greater threat looming over them all.


Kensy and Max 10: Time’s Up The Spencers have been targeted before, but never like this. As their closest allies disappear one by one, Kensy and Max must uncover the truth before Pharos falls apart—and their family is lost forever.


For fans of fast-paced espionage, daring missions, and gripping twists, The Kensy and Max Collection: Volume 2 delivers an unforgettable conclusion to this bestselling spy series.
